messages:
Maya CS: Heads-up — ArborHealth needs a concise preflight for private deploy: minimal firewall ports, KMS key policy template, and Splunk audit-forward test steps. @Owen NetEng @Priya Security @Sam Solutions

Owen NetEng: Minimal ports:
- Ingress 443 from LB CIDR (10.8.32.0/24) to fleet ENIs only.
- Egress 443 to our control-plane IPs (we'll share).
- Egress 443 to telemetry.redwood.example.com via NAT.
- Optional: 22 limited to jump host, 5000-5002 TCP for internal probes if required.
Will attach a tiny Terraform SG snippet.

Priya Security: KMS notes:
- Deny CreateGrant/RetireGrant except for our service principal.
- Add STS condition for their Splunk delivery role ARN.
- Explicit Deny for DeleteKey unless from org-admin OIDC role.
I'll post a minimal JSON key policy example to the ticket.

Sam Solutions: Proposed smoke runbook:
1) Customer adds SG rule LB CIDR -> fleet 443.
2) Customer provides Splunk HEC URL + token and delivery IAM role ARN.
3) We test ingest from staging forwarder; validate TLS cert CN and token validity.
4) 1-hour smoke: sample inference, check audit entries in Splunk, verify metrics.
Rollback: revoke peering or remove LB route.

infra-bot: CI preflight: "arborhealth-preflight" 6/7 checks passed. Failing: splunk-hec-connectivity (tls_handshake_error: CN mismatch; token expired -> 401). CI link: https://ci.redwood/integrations/arborhealth/789

Maya CS: Action items:
- @Owen publish SG/Terraform snippet + NAT/control-plane IP list today.
- @Priya update KMS example with STS condition and small auditor note.
- @Sam hold tentative smoke Wed 10-11am PT pending Splunk cert/token fixes.
Customer will reissue HEC token (90d TTL) and ensure cert matches HEC domain.

Owen NetEng: Posting SG snippet + NAT IPs by 4pm PT.

Priya Security: Adding STS binding and audit validation note now.

Sam Solutions: Tentative slot booked, will confirm after infra-bot shows splunk check green.

Maya CS: Thanks team — will notify ArborHealth once infra-bot passes.
